**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 22 (Audit Rights) is the document's only usage-verification right binding us — a regex sweep for inspection, verification, monitoring and remote-access language turned up nothing else, and § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) has no operative text.

The clause sits at the **preferred** position on all material terms:
- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (§ 22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice (§ 22.1)
- **Manner:** normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2)
- **System access:** expressly barred — Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information (§ 22.2)

Section 22.3 adds further customer-favourable protection (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closes the issue absent fraud or demonstrable error).
